subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella and approve the Track A-D sequencing?
rationale: The source gaps are real and VISION.md supports stability work, but the solution chooses cross-cutting lifecycle ownership, persistence, liveness policy, Codex-wrapper behavior, and user-visible terminal semantics across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt the staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner direction and require each track to land as a focused PR with source, upgrade, and live behavior proof.

options.title: Approve only Track A/B now
options.body: Use this issue for abort-to-release and evidence-based liveness while deferring durability and completion-drive policy to separate maintainer decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue using the narrower linked issues and PRs as the canonical tracking points for each reliability symptom.

recommendation.title: Adopt the staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner direction and require each track to land as a focused PR with source, upgrade, and live behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, self-assigned, and expanded the umbrella and is already driving the linked staged PRs and design comments.
